caveats: Pivoted: Playgent now sells finance-specific RL environments and post-training data (expert-curated tasks, verifier rubrics, environments with MCP tools) for investment-banking agents. This is a data/environment vendor sold by contact form, not a compute sandbox product. No pricing (/pricing 404), docs, console or self-serve access.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.
Buying process is sales-only: 'Contact us to discuss your use case and access our RL environments.' No self-serve signup exists (app./docs. subdomains do not resolve).
